equity.level_reason: Single occupational case report; occupation is a route of exposure, not social position, and no SPD is reported.

notes: The Discussion adds a count of 326 occupationally exposed Florida HCP (by exposure-risk level) with one infection; treated as descriptive context to the single case. Prepass cues for diagnostic accuracy ('sensitivity of real-time PCR assays') and percentage (povidone-iodine 10%) are false hits; PCR only confirms case status.
